english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making something better or for a situation that is getting better.
Use 改善 as the all-purpose choice for making a situation, quality, or result better.

examples.english: This new arrangement will improve the workflow.
examples.traditional: 呢個新安排會改善工作流程。
